title: Community hit gap: the community row's gap is never smaller than the distance that keeps neighbouring 44px hit areas apart, so no two hit areas cross at any title size
first: Finding: site-masthead:finding:cut-home-flat.s1.github-hit-overlap (Low). At 360 and 375 wide the title is 1.9rem, so each community box is 0.92em = 27.97px wide and the row gap 0.35em = 10.64px; neighbour centres are 38.6px apart while each ::after hit area is 44px wide, so Discord's hit area covers the right 5.4px of GitHub's and 22 of 121 sampled taps on GitHub open Discord.

Rules: .gamecult-titlebar-community (custom.scss 725-733: gap 0.35em, font-size var(--gamecult-title-size)); .gamecult-nav-wordmark::after, .gamecult-nav-icon::after (754-763: width and height max(100%, 44px), centred). --gamecult-title-size is clamp(2.1rem, 4vw, 3.3rem) (645) and 1.9rem under $mobile (1351).

Chosen: a gap floor, not clipped hit areas. Clipping each hit area to the midpoint keeps the row tight but makes the target smaller than 44px (WCAG 2.5.8's floor) exactly where fingers are, and it needs a second geometry (half-gap offsets) that must agree with the first. A gap floor keeps every target 44px square and states the invariant in one place: neighbouring centres are at least the hit size apart. One line changes.

Mechanism: the hit size becomes a token on the row, --gamecult-hit: 44px, read by the ::after rule (max(100%, var(--gamecult-hit))) and by the gap: gap: max(0.35em, calc(var(--gamecult-hit) + 1px - 0.92em)). At desktop sizes 0.92em exceeds 44px, the calc is negative and 0.35em wins, so nothing changes; at 1.9rem the gap becomes 17.03px, centres are 45px apart, and the hit areas do not touch. 0.92em is the box width named in .gamecult-nav-icon (750); the wordmark is wider, so its neighbour distance is larger still.
Not this cut: the glyph sizes, the glow, the title size, the wordmark's own width, and anything outside the community row.
